title: SB 324 (2023-2024 (135th General Assembly)): S. B. No. 324: Require citizenship proof to register to vote;revise election law
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) not stated.
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) R.C. 3503.202(C)(1)
(quote) Except as otherwise provided in division (B) of this section, at the first election at which the elector appears to vote, the elector shall vote by provisional ballot under section 3505.181 of the Revised Code.
(section) R.C. 3503.202(C)(2)
(quote) If the board must verify the elector's Ohio driver's license or state identification card number or the last four digits of the elector's social security number, then in order for the elector's provisional ballot to be eligible to be counted, in addition to meeting all other requirements described in division (B)(3) of section 3505.183 of the Revised Code, the elector shall provide at least one of the following on the provisional ballot affirmation or shall appear in person at the office of the board within four days after the day of the election and provide at least one of the following: (a) An Ohio driver's license or state identification card that exists in the records of the bureau of motor vehicles and is associated with the elector's first name, last name, and date of birth, as confirmed by the secretary of state; (b) The last four digits of a social security number that exists in the records of the United States social security administration and is associated with the elector's first name, last name, and date of birth, as confirmed by the secretary of state;
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship)
(section) R.C. 3503.01(A)(2)
(quote) Except as otherwise provided in division (A)(3) of this section, an elector who registers to vote or submits a change of residence or change of name form on or after the effective date of this amendment shall provide proof of citizenship to the board of elections. An elector whose registration record indicates that the elector has provided proof of citizenship to a board of elections is not required to provide proof of citizenship when subsequently registering to vote or updating the elector's registration in this state.
(section) R.C. 3503.01(A)(3)
(quote) An elector who registers to vote or updates the elector's registration on a form prescribed under 52 U.S.C. 20301, 20303, or 20508 is not required to provide proof of citizenship under division (A)(2) of this section.
(section) R.C. 3501.01(EE)(1)
(quote) "Proof of citizenship" means evidence that an individual is a United States citizen, in the form of one of the following: (a) The number of the individual's current or expired Ohio driver's license or state identification card, if the board of elections verifies using information obtained from the bureau of motor vehicles that the individual has submitted documentation to the bureau that indicates that the individual is a United States citizen; (b) The individual's current or expired Ohio driver's license, state identification card, or interim identification form issued on or after April 7, 2023, or a copy of the front and back of that license, card, or form, if the license, card, or form does not include a notation designating that the individual is a noncitizen of the United States; (c) ... driver's license or nondriver identification card issued by another state ... if the issuing agency indicates on the license or card that the individual is a United States citizen; (d) The individual's birth certificate, certification of report of birth, or consular report of birth abroad, or a copy of one of those documents; (e) The individual's current or expired United States passport or passport card ... ; (f) The individual's certificate of naturalization or certificate of citizenship or a copy of one of those documents.
(section) R.C. 3503.201(A)
(quote) When the board of elections receives a voter registration application or a notice of change of address or change of name, the board shall attempt to verify the applicant's United States citizenship by doing one of the following: (1) Confirming that the applicant has provided proof of citizenship and noting that fact in the applicant's voter registration record. ... (2) Determining that the applicant's existing voter registration record obtained from the statewide voter registration database indicates that a board of elections has previously verified the applicant as a United States citizen.
(section) R.C. 3503.201(B)(1)(b)
(quote) If the board receives a voter registration form, notice of change of address, or notice of change of name on a form prescribed under 52 U.S.C. 20301, 20303, or 20508, and the board is unable to verify the applicant's United States citizenship under division (A) of this section, but the form is otherwise valid and the board is satisfied as to the truth of the statements made in the form, the board shall register the applicant or update the applicant's registration, as applicable, and shall note in the applicant's registration record that the applicant has not provided proof of citizenship.
(section) R.C. 3505.181(B)(9)
(quote) For a provisional ballot to be eligible to be counted when it is cast by an individual who has changed the individual's name or moved within the state, has not submitted a notice of change of address or change of name, as described in division (A)(6) of section 3505.181 of the Revised Code, and has not previously provided proof of citizenship to a board of elections in this state, the individual shall submit proof of citizenship to the board of elections with the individual's provisional ballot or within four days after the day of the election.
(e_other_rule)
(section) R.C. 3503.14(A)(5)
(quote) One of the following forms of identification and proof of citizenship: (a) The applicant's Ohio driver's license or state identification card number, which the board of elections shall use to verify that the individual has submitted documentation to the bureau of motor vehicles that indicates that the individual is a United States citizen; (b) The last four digits of the applicant's social security number and proof of citizenship. (the words 'and proof of citizenship' and the clause after 'number' in (a) are new)
(section) R.C. 3503.151(E)(1)(a)
(quote) The record contains neither an Ohio driver's license or state identification card number nor the last four digits of a social security number.
(section) R.C. 3503.16(B)(1)(a)
(quote) STRUCK: Any registered elector who moves within a precinct on or prior to the day of a general, primary, or special election and has not filed a notice of change of residence with the board of elections may vote in that election by going to that registered elector's assigned polling place, completing and signing a notice of change of residence, showing photo identification, and casting a ballot.
(other) 3501.38, 3501.381, 3501.39, 3513.xx, 3517.xx, 3519.xx: election petition rules (circulator badges, statements, signature checks)
(other) 303.12, 303.59, 307.94: township and county zoning-referendum petitions
(other) 3503.13, 3503.15: records note proof of citizenship and verification date
(other) 3503.151, 3503.152: weekly data-match report; people without proof must provide it or cancel
(other) 3503.16, 3503.19, 3503.21: mover rules and cancellation process
(other) 3503.201, 3503.202 (new): citizenship verification at registration; verification-flag procedure with provisional ballot
(other) 3505.182-3505.183, 3505.20, 3509.05, 3509.08, 3599.21: provisional envelope, challenge, absentee and penalty changes
(other) note: Documentary proof of citizenship for registering or updating on a state form; people using a federal form are exempt from the proof rule and are registered with a note. Photo ID at the polls is not in this bill's amended sections (3505.18 is not amended), so slot a is not stated. Quote (b)/(c)/(e) of the definition are shortened with ellipses where text repeats. Sole version.
